stories.title: Polls open in Higher Kinnerton by-election for Flintshire County Council seat
stories.summary: Polls have opened in Higher Kinnerton, where voters are choosing a new Flintshire County Council councillor in a by-election today. Polling stations are open from 7am until 10pm on Thursday 15 October. The by-election follows the resignation of Mike Allport, who held the seat as an Independent. stories.title: Broken-down train at Gwersyllt disrupts Wrexham to Bidston services
stories.summary: Rail passengers on the Wrexham to Bidston line face delays and cancellations this morning after a train broke down at Gwersyllt. Transport for Wales said services may be delayed by up to 60 minutes and could be cancelled in both directions between Wrexham Central and Bidston.
